APPROVE

The extracted `AppendStar` preserves the original logic for `*`, `**/` and trailing `**`, including the returned index (`i`, `i+2`, `i+1`) that replaces the old `i += 2` and `i++`. Removing the deeply nested if/else block from `ToRegex` drops its cognitive complexity well below 15. The new helper is a plain private static method with no obvious warning triggers, though I did not run the build.
